We focus on what matters most. Our patients. We know we’re only at our best when we’re helping you get better.

That’s why, at Orthopedic ONE, we bring our best every day to earn your trust.  With nearly 70 of the region’s top general and fellowship trained orthopedic experts, nearly 200 physical and occupational therapists, and a team of more than 700 caring associates, Orthopedic ONE is the largest physician owned orthopedic surgery practice.

Ranked #1 in Ohio and #3 in the Nation for Orthopedics, our care & patient-first experience are award-winning. 

Start with the Specialists at Orthopedic ONE. No Referral Required.
